client: Luna, I've been feeling really overwhelmed lately when I think about going to that café where my ex and I used to meet. therapist: It sounds like you're really grappling with a lot of anxiety and overwhelm when it comes to that café and the memories tied to it. It’s understandable to want to avoid a place that brings up such intense feelings, but it seems like this is starting to impact your daily life significantly. Therapy can be a space to explore these feelings further and help you find ways to cope, so you can feel more in control and less overwhelmed.
